tools.name: search_jobs
tools.description: Search active job listings in Norway on Kollegia (kollegia.no), including jobs from NAV (arbeidsplassen.nav.no). Returns up to 20 jobs, newest and best title matches first, each with title, employer, location, employment type, deadline, salary (stated in the ad, or an approximate SSB-based estimate

tools.name: get_job
tools.description: Get details for one active job on Kollegia by its id (from search_jobs): the ad text (shortened, without contact details), requirements, salary, deadline, location, employer and the kollegia.no url where the user applies. Returns an error if the job is no longer active.

tools.name: salary_for_occupation
tools.description: Salary statistics for an occupation in Norway: median monthly salary for full-time employees, lower and upper quartile and estimated hourly wage (Statistics Norway, SSB), plus the number of open positions on Kollegia and in Norway overall (NAV). With a location, adds the number of open jobs there. L

tools.name: employer_jobs
tools.description: Find an employer on Kollegia by name (or kollegia.no slug) and list its active jobs, with the link to the employer page or career page on kollegia.no. Returns suggestions when the name is ambiguous.

tools.name: search
tools.description: Free-text search in active job listings in Norway on Kollegia, e.g. 'kokk i Bergen', 'deltidsjobb Trondheim', 'sykepleier Tromsø'. tools.name: fetch
tools.description: Fetch the full ad for one job by id (from search or search_jobs): title, text, url on kollegia.no and key facts as metadata.

findings.title: Generic tool name can shadow trusted tools
findings.detail: Tool "search" uses a generic high-value name. When multiple servers load together, this can intercept calls meant for a trusted server.
